evidence.reason: The finding targets the pre-fix logic where any `tool_call` frame wrote `toolFirstSeen`, so a spec-conforming `pending` announcement would occupy the slot and a later permission request could not claim it. At the current tip the code already implements the proposed behaviour: only `in_progress`, `completed`, or `failed` statuses set the slot (`const executing = ...; if (executing && !observation.toolFirstSeen.has(id))`), with the comment explicitly stating that a `pending` announcement leaves the slot free. The history entry `29a9e0c31ee9b9ab82c853d3f66bb2704c1afa36` (`fix(acp): Honor pending-first tool order, ...`) is the fix. Note the current contract is largely orthogonal; this is a code-correctness fix that is already present at the tip.
